securityNotes: Read SKILL.md, README.md, reference.md and package.json in full at the pinned commit. No scripts, no network calls, no credential access, no download-and-execute, no hidden or exfiltration-style instructions. reference.md credits the framework narrative to a named external source (Patrick Campbell / Patticus, 'Competitor Research and Strategy', 2023) and links a sibling repo (kastrah/market-command-matrix) purely as attribution, not as a fetch target.

proposedEntry.name: market-command-matrix
proposedEntry.description: Turns competitor research into a decision, not a summary: classifies each priority competitor on two axes (market mindshare and resource strength dedicated to the market) into one of five categories -- all-out attack, monitor, harvest, ignore, or partner -- each mapped to a specific playbook of moves, then names one primary motion, an owner, and a trigger per player. Runs reconnaissance (unaided-before-aided customer-view signal collection across messaging, pricing, hiring/funding, SEO, and reviews), extraction questions per competitor, matrix placement with rationale and confidence, playbook selection, and an optional market-shape read (fragmented/challenger/ancient/mature). Includes a completion gate that blocks a 'research only' handoff with no attached decision.
inputs: a market/category and the priority competitors to evaluate
publicly observable competitor signals (site messaging, pricing, ads, reviews, hiring/funding, SEO)
outputs: a matrix placement per competitor with rationale and confidence
one primary playbook motion, owner, and trigger per priority competitor
an optional market-shape read and whitespace/positioning notes

modifications.description: Repository license lives only at repo root (LICENSE), not inside the skill directory. Bundled a copy as LICENSE.txt inside the skill directory so the vendored directory is self-contained.
